status.scope_reason: Metagenics manufactures and sells finished magnesium glycinate supplement tablets under its own brand name which are directly available to consumers in the MENA market via retailers like Nahdi Pharmacy in Saudi Arabia.
status.evidence: Metagenics is active as a portfolio company of Gryphon Investors following its 2021 acquisition, and its Magnesium Glycinate 100 mg tablets are actively distributed in the MENA region through major pharmacies like Nahdi Pharmacy in Saudi Arabia.

claims.claim: The company's core Magnesium Glycinate supplement product label explicitly states that each 1-tablet serving delivers 100 mg of elemental magnesium derived from magnesium bis-glycinate, as verified on the Metagenics US product listing.

The company offers an "Extra Strength" variation of the product line, which is explicitly labeled to deliver 140 mg of elemental magnesium per 1-tablet serving as magnesium bis-glycinate, as documented on the Metagenics official product catalog.

The company markets a powdered formulation under the brand name MetaRelax, which delivers 150 mg of elemental magnesium per 3.3 g serving from magnesium bis-glycinate combined with taurine, GABA, and B vitamins, as distributed in regional storefronts like Amazon UAE.
claims.corrected: The company markets a powdered formulation under the brand name MetaRelax, which delivers 150 mg of elemental magnesium per 3.3 g serving from magnesium bis-glycinate combined with taurine, folate, and B vitamins, as distributed in regional storefronts like Amazon UAE.

claims.claim: The company distributes its standard 100 mg Magnesium Glycinate 240-tablet variant directly into the MENA retail pharmacy network via localized digital platforms like Nahdi Online in Saudi Arabia.
The company reports that each regular strength tablet provides 100 mg of elemental magnesium derived from 740 mg of fully reacted magnesium bisglycinate.

The company provides an Extra Strength variation of its magnesium glycinate formulation, which increases the elemental mineral potency per tablet to 140 mg compared to its standard 100 mg tablet variant.

Metagenics offers its single-ingredient Magnesium Glycinate 100 mg tablets, distributed in 120-tablet and 240-tablet configurations, within the MENA market via retail channels including Nahdi Online in Saudi Arabia and Amazon UAE.

The company provides its combination formula MetaRelax Magnesium Glycinate Powder, supplying 150 mg of magnesium per serving alongside taurine and B-vitamins in a 30-serving orange citrus format, available through Amazon UAE.

The company distributes its MegaMag Energen Plus Magnesium Glycinate Powder in a 30-serving raspberry format, combining 200 mg of magnesium glycinate with B-vitamins, malic acid, N-acetyl carnitine, and ashwagandha, available via Noon UAE.
claims.corrected: The company distributes its MegaMag Energen Plus Magnesium Glycinate Powder in a 30-serving orange format, combining 200 mg of magnesium glycinate with B-vitamins, malic acid, N-acetyl carnitine, and ashwagandha, available via Noon UAE.

claims.claim: The company's manufacturing processes hold independent third-party certifications including United States Pharmacopeia (USP) Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) audit certification, National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) International GMP certification, and NSF Certified for Sport.

The company participates in the independent verification program TESTED by SuppCo, which anonymously purchases its supplements through normal retail channels and tests active ingredients at ISO 17025-accredited third-party labs to verify identity and potency against label claims.
The company's magnesium glycinate product strength is validated by regular third-party testing for precise dosing and is sold within the MENA market via channels like Amazon UAE.
The company provides batch-specific testing information and Certificates of Analysis (COAs) accessible to consumers online through its TruQuality transparency program.
claims.note: batch-specific testing information and Certificates of Analysis (COAs) accessible to consumers online
claims.source: Metagenics Quality and Corporate Press Releases (https://yahoo.com and https://supp.co)

claims.claim: The company holds a Certified Gluten-Free seal from the Gluten-Free Certification Organization (GFCO) following a comprehensive audit of its final products and raw materials suppliers.
claims.source: Metagenics Official Product FAQs and GFCO Catalog (https://metagenics.com)

claims.claim: Metagenics Magnesium Glycinate (100 mg tablets in 120 and 240 count configurations) is listed and sold through Nahdi Pharmacy, a major retail pharmacy chain in Saudi Arabia.

Metagenics, LLC products, including its Magnesium Glycinate 100 mg tablets (120 and 240 count configurations), are actively listed and stocked by Nahdi Medical Company, the largest retail pharmacy chain in Saudi Arabia, as documented on the Nahdi Online ecommerce platform.

Metagenics Magnesium Glycinate products are widely distributed across the UAE market via cross-border and digital storefront platforms including Carrefour UAE (fulfilled via third-party global partners), Amazon UAE, and Noon.com.
